ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food web diagram, what happens to the guava population if all the beetles die?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a food web. On the right side, the “beetle” label can be seen located above the “guava” label, and there is an arrow pointing downward from beetle to guava. Then reason: This indicates that beetles will feed on or affect guava. If all beetles die, guava will no longer be under feeding pressure from beetles, so the number of guava will increase.
